title: Renewal Loyalty Rate — Tailwise Plus Overdue Fee Terms (Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus)
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus.** A renewal loyalty rate is a percentage reduction of the overdue fee collected to reinstate a past-due Tailwise Plus Annual or Tailwise Plus Premier Annual membership. It rests on two facts: the membership fee charges on the rewards history dated in the last 36 months, and the full calendar months the membership has been enrolled.

**Terms.** A membership with at least 2 membership fees charged in the last 36 months and enrolled for at least 60 months takes 10% (0.1). A membership that does not meet both of those conditions but has at least one membership fee charged in the last 36 months and is enrolled for at least 24 months takes 5% (0.05). Any other membership takes no renewal loyalty rate.

| Fees charged in the last 36 months | Months enrolled | Renewal loyalty rate |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | 60 or more | 10% |
| 2 or more | 24 to 59 | 5% |
| exactly 1 | 24 or more | 5% |
| any | fewer than 24 | none |
| none | any | none |

**Example (hypothetical).** One fee in the last 36 months and 80 months enrolled: 5% — the 60-month condition is met but the fee count is not.
